experience.title: Governance and compliance co-op trainee
experience.description: Went through the regulator's cyber framework control by control with each department, marked which controls the company already meets and which it does not, and turned the missing ones into a tracked action list of 46 items. Collected screenshots, configurations and signed records as proof for 120 controls ahead of the external auditors' visit, and checked each one against what the control actually asks for. Sent questionnaires to nine suppliers who handle policyholder data, scored their answers and flagged two for follow-up. Rewrote the acceptable-use and password rules as two short documents that staff can actually read; the committee approved both in June. Ran the quarterly fake-phishing email exercise for 600 staff and gave a 20-minute talk to the 48 who clicked. Kept the department's list of open threats up to date: owner, likelihood, impact and what is being done about each. Wrote the monthly compliance status summary that goes to the head of cybersecurity.
